audience: online shops that ship parcels with GHN

useCases.title: Quote a shipping fee before an order
useCases.text: Find the province, district and ward codes, then quote the fee for the parcel. No order is created.

useCases.title: Check which services a route offers
useCases.text: List the delivery services GHN offers on a route. Use the service type before you quote a fee.

useCases.title: Check the status of a shipping order
useCases.text: Read one order by its GHN tracking code or by your own client order code.

useCases.title: Create a cash-on-delivery order
useCases.text: Quote the fee first. After the customer confirms the recipient and parcel, create the order. A repeated client order code returns the first order.

useCases.title: Cancel shipping orders in one batch
useCases.text: Check the orders, then cancel them after the customer confirms. If one code is unknown, the batch cancels nothing.
